title: Retinue of the Vampire Lord
html:
Retinue of the Vampire Lord is a unique Class Action only available during the Confront the Elder Brain quest. It allows the party to summon 2 Shadows, 2 Giant Skeletons, a Ghast, a Shadow Mastiff and a Werewolf in the final battle.

Description

Summon an undead horde to overwhelm a section of the battlefield.

Dismissed after combat until re-summoned.
Can't be summoned again if killed in combat.
